title.zh: 【芝加哥期权交易所：可能与标普道琼斯工业平均指数探索代币化期权合约等新产品】
title.en: 【芝加哥期权交易所：可能与标普道琼斯工业平均指数探索代币化期权合约等新产品】

current_state.zh: Cboe and S&P Dow Jones Indices extended their exclusive licensing agreement by 25 years through 2051, preserving Cboe's exclusive SPX options trading rights while signaling possible joint exploration of tokenized options contracts and other new index-derived products.
